endDateTimeOnLocal.description: The date, time and time zone that the SDT will end at

monthDay.description: 1 | 2....| 31 The day of the month that the SDT will be active for a monthly SDT

weekOfMonth.description: The weel of the month that the SDT will be active for a monthly SDT

admin.description: The name of the user that created the SDT

endDateTime.description: The epoch time, in milliseconds, that the SDT will end

type.description: The type resource that this SDT is for: ServiceSDT | CollectorSDT | DeviceDataSourceInstanceSDT | DeviceBatchJobSDT | DeviceClusterAlertDefSDT | DeviceDataSourceInstanceGroupSDT | DeviceDataSourceSDT | DeviceEventSourceSDT | DeviceGroupSDT | DeviceSDT | WebsiteCheckpointSDT | WebsiteGroupSDT | WebsiteSDT

isEffective.description:
true: the SDT is currently actice
false: the SDT is currently inactive

minute.description: 1 | 2....| 60 The minute of the hour that the SDT should begin for a repeating SDT

duration.description: The duration of the SDT in minutes

endHour.description: 1 | 2....| 24 The hour that the SDT ends for a repeating SDT

startDateTime.description: The epoch time, in milliseconds, that the SDT will start

hour.description: 1 | 2....| 24 The hour that the SDT will start for a repeating SDT (daily, weekly, or monthly)

startDateTimeOnLocal.description: The date, time and time zone that the SDT will end at

comment.description: The notes associated with the SDT

id.description: The Id of the SDT. This value will be in the following format "XX_##" where XX will refer to the type of SDT and ## will refer to the number of SDTs of that type

endMinute.description: 1 | 2....| 60 The minute of the hour that the SDT ends for a repeating SDT
